start: Android phone, just joined a gym that has a logo (https) and branding; offer not shown before for this gym code

steps.action: Join the gym; the pop-up appears
user_sees: 'Put <gym> on your home screen'
'<gym>'s logo opens MettleUp in your gym's look.'
Buttons 'Add to home screen' and 'Not now'
must_not: The pop-up for a gym with no logo
Another gym's logo

steps.action: Tap 'Add to home screen'
user_sees: 'Tap Add on your phone's question. Then come back here.'
Android's own add-shortcut question
must_not: A shortcut added without Android's question

steps.action: Tap Add on Android's question, come back, tap 'I added it'
user_sees: 'Last step: remove the MettleUp icon' with 3 steps and 'MettleUp stays on your phone, in your app list. Only its icon leaves the home screen. Don't tap Uninstall.'
must_not: Advice that removes the app itself

steps.action: Tap the new home-screen icon
user_sees: MettleUp opens in the gym's look
must_not: The icon opening a blank screen

start: Settings → Your gym, row 'Gym logo on my home screen' ('Opens MettleUp from your home screen')

steps.action: Tap the row
user_sees: Android's add-shortcut question
must_not: The row on a phone that cannot pin shortcuts

steps.action: Tap it again when the shortcut is already there
user_sees: '<gym> is already on your home screen. Its picture is up to date.'
must_not: A second icon added

start: Pop-up shown, member taps 'Not now' (or refuses Android's question)

steps.action: Tap 'Not now'
user_sees: The pop-up closes and is not offered again for this gym
must_not: The pop-up returning on every visit

steps.action: From the row in Settings, cancel Android's question then tap 'I added it'
user_sees: 'Not added' and 'Your gym's icon was not added. You can add it any time in Settings → Your gym.'
must_not: 'Last step' shown when nothing was added

start: Gym without a logo, or offline when the logo must download

steps.action: Open Settings → Your gym
user_sees: No 'Gym logo on my home screen' row (no logo)
must_not: A row that only fails

steps.action: With a logo but offline, tap the row
user_sees: 'Couldn't get <gym>'s logo. Check the internet and try again.'
must_not: A shortcut with a broken picture

start: Shortcut on the home screen; the gym changes its logo, then the member leaves the gym

steps.action: The gym uploads a new logo; open the app
user_sees: The home-screen icon is redrawn with the new logo, no question asked
must_not: The old logo kept
A second icon pinned

steps.action: Leave the gym
user_sees: The shortcut is greyed out with 'You left <gym>. Open MettleUp from its own icon.'
must_not: The shortcut still opening the gym's look after leaving
